g.text: Tuesday 14 July, 09:10. Okafor reads a context the way he reads a ledger: who is spending, and on what.
You give him the count from Monday as one number. He hands it back.
"A total tells me nothing. I want it by account." He draws columns: standing orders, memory, summaries,
tool descriptions, history, evidence, the question. "And I want to know what is left for the answer."
Varma, passing: "And what happens when it does not balance."
You know the answer to that one from case file 01. Nothing happens. The oldest part goes missing and

The baseline, and the same context with fewer tool schemas
The window has accounts. Of 5,410 tokens of input, the tool schemas take 1,891 (35%) and the evidence
takes 316 (5.8%); 88% is sent with every question whatever it asks. With every version of the standing
orders loaded by mistake the input was 19,343 tokens, Ollama read 4,098 and answered without a word
about the rest. The context builder now refuses that request and names the account. Sending 3 tool
